notes.title: Update 0.25.6
notes.notes:
Hi guys. Thank you so much to everyone who experienced the game. I watched your gameplay videos and received your comments 😍 I noticed that one of the puzzles seems a bit difficult. That's why I tried to add more hints for it in this update, and I also made some minor changes to improve the gaming experience. I hope you enjoy the game. I'm looking forward to your videos and comments 😉🎮
